hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox ramps up its electoral campaign for November 29 with high-profile rallies, anti-immigration rhetoric, and unconventional digital outreach including a political video game. Party figures emphasize strict border controls, national priority in housing, and heavy friction with rival parties.
hotspots.affect: High-intensity electoral mobilization fueled by anti-immigrant grievances and provocative cultural warfare tactics.

hotspots.title: Macron-Le Pen Clash Over Ukraine Aid & 2027
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen's 2027 presidential bid and pension reform proposals draw fierce counter-attacks from government figures warning of economic and geopolitical disaster. Simultaneously, reports highlight foreign financial entanglements and intense polarization around her platform.
hotspots.affect: Intense national anxiety over the looming 2027 presidential showdown and the far-right's systemic challenge to French economic policy.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Ratifies 2027 Reelection Bid
hotspots.blurb: Javier Milei doubles down on his political alliances, cementing ties with Patricia Bullrich while aggressively dismissing public economic distress. His administration faces fierce blowback from economists like Domingo Cavallo while aggressively pushing structural reforms and suspension of primaries.
hotspots.affect: High-stakes political confrontation over economic reality, party discipline, and the restructuring of Argentine electoral rules.

hotspots.title: Moraes Bars Allied Visits to Imprisoned Bolsonaro
hotspots.blurb: Legal pressures tighten around the Bolsonarista camp as the Supreme Court maintains strict measures against Jair Bolsonaro and prosecutors formally denounce Flávio Bolsonaro over social media attacks. Allies rally against judicial overreach while facing internal parliamentary friction.
hotspots.affect: Deep systemic grievance and outrage directed at the judiciary, framing legal accountability as political persecution.

hotspots.title: Meloni-Salvini Clash Over Budget & Quota 64
hotspots.blurb: Tensions simmer within the Italian right-wing coalition as Giorgia Meloni navigates European Central Bank leadership moves and domestic tax disputes, while Matteo Salvini's faction pushes alternative economic and administrative appointments.
hotspots.affect: Intra-coalition friction and high-stakes maneuvering over economic policy, state budgets, and key institutional posts.
